inputs.question: Are proposed improvements adjacent to or encroaching into the right-of-way identified and labeled on this site plan? Look for callouts or labels identifying work in or near the ROW areas such as sidewalk improvements, driveway connections, utility connections, curb and gutter, or ROW dedications along S Lamar Blvd, Collier Street, Kinney Avenue, and Nash Avenue.
inputs.reasoning: The agent is asking whether proposed improvements adjacent to or encroaching into ROW are identified and labeled on the site plan—this requires visual inspection of drawing annotations, callouts, and labels in specific ROW areas, not a measurement or document-presence check.
